works.title: Spiritual Practice Book
works.description: A book on spiritual practice grounded in personal experience with Tibetan Buddhist meditation (specifically Tonglen practice), exploring how continuous exchange-of-self practice becomes habituated and transforms the inner world. The user plans to write it with a warm, conversational tone that feels like advice from a supportive friend, with subtle humor in sidebars marked clearly. The book will validate readers' spiritual experiences by grounding them in traditional contemplative practice.
works.quote: I wanted to register a diary entry note about spiritual practice. One of the things that has been notable and perhaps surprising to me is noticing the concerns that fill my mind.

works.title: This Is How You Do It - AI-Assisted Writing Methodology Book Series
works.description: A book series documenting the user's AI-augmented narrative engineering methodology. The first book covers the method itself (outlining process, query construction, material preparation), with follow-up books demonstrating the methodology in action using the author's published outlines. Focuses on front-loaded design, outlining at scale, and cognitive leverage provided by AI tools in fiction writing. Planned for fall release after the methodology is fully refined through multiple projects.
works.quote: You're right that I ultimately need to write about the method and document the queries I use, or at least document the process of copying and pasting materials to construct the queries—because that's really how my queries are constructed... I'm writing a book about my methods until at least fall, not winter.
